description: MECHANISM: only a handler's BODY is dispatch-dependent — its HEAD arguments are ordinary expressions, evaluated where the handler is registered, and are judged in the enclosing context (issue #1155). `every repcount [ … ]` at top level reads a turn that does not exist at registration time, so it is a fault; `repeat 2 [ every repcount [ … ] ]` is clean, which the unit suite pins. Measured falsification: leaving head arguments unchecked while still deferring the body kills this fixture and no other. (An earlier draft instead claimed that skipping the WHOLE `ProfileStatement` leaves every other fixture green. That is false twice over — whole-statement skipping also kills `check/repcount-in-procedure-inside-handler` — and it carried a stale fixture count besides. The narrower mutation named here is the one this fixture is the sole wall for.)
